metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented an IGES CLI tool in `output/` (Node.js stdlib only) with subcommands `parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, and `roundtrip`, plus the required diagnostic JSON envelope on failures.

- Entry point: `output/main.js`
- Binary name wrapper: `output/iges` (executes `output/main.js`)
- Core modules:
  - `output/iges_parse.js` (80-col fixed-format parsing, section splitting, Start/Global/Directory/Parameter parsing, pointer checks, required Global numeric validation, spec_version clamping, degenerate Line(110) rejection)
  - `output/iges_write.js` (deterministic 80-col writer with correct section sequencing + single T line; explicit Hollerith delimiters in Global)
  - `output/iges_eval.js` (parametric evaluation with xform application order; currently supports Types `110` and `100`)
  - `output/iges_types.js` (typed PD decoding for a subset; other catalog types preserved as `raw_fields` for roundtrip)

Run as:
- `node output/main.js parse --input file.iges --output out.json`
- `node output/main.js write --input file.json --output out.iges`
- `node output/main.js query --input file.iges --de 1 --output entity.json`
- `node output/main.js eval --input file.iges --de 1 --t 0.5 --output point.json`
- `node output/main.js roundtrip --input file.iges --output out.iges`
